text: BREAKING: GameInformer’s next cover features GTA 6 with 14-pages of exclusive interviews with Rockstar, plus a dozen new screenshots. It releases digitally next week. @RockstarGames 😠
The GTA 6 Collector’s Box features items that are actually present in the game world, including Macca the Gator’s figure and the New Era 9Forty snapback hat. @RockstarGames 😠

Rockstar Collector Editions comparison: - GTA 5: $150 with 6 items (game included) - Red Dead Redemption 2: $100 with 9 items (no game included) - GTA 6: $400 with 11 items (no game included) The GTA 6 Collector’s Edition is the most expensive mainly because of the Oakley sunglasses, which alone cost more than half the price of the bundle. @RockstarGames 😠
The “i” in Vice got damaged and is now missing the pink outline in the new GTA 6 sign. Rockstar paid $1 million for this btw @RockstarGames 😠

There are only 8 Thursdays left until the GTA 6 launch, so it’s reasonable to expect a new announcement every Thursday leading up to release. In fact, there has been a new announcement every Thursday since the Extended Look on August 27: - September 3: Limited Edition DualSense reveal - September 10: DualSense pre-orders - September 17: Album announcement and pre-orders On the last Thursday before release (November 12), pre-loading will begin. @RockstarGames 😠
